text:
I'm sorry the pot arrived cracked. A cracked pot counts as damaged on arrival, but the report window is **48 hours from delivery**, so you're right at the limit and should report it right away.

- **If you're still within 48 hours:** report it with photos of the pot and the box. You can choose a **replacement or a refund**, and since the pot is under $40, you usually won't have to send it back.
- **If it's just past 48 hours:** the policy doesn't say what happens to non-living items after the window, and I can't promise an exception. I can escalate your case to a Support Lead to review.

Your plant is fine, so it isn't affected. If you can tell me roughly when it was delivered, I can help work out which situation you're in.
